statement: Pi intentionally omits a built-in subagent orchestration policy; its official project guidance points users to separate Pi processes or extensions so delegation semantics remain outside the minimal core.

display_text.zh-CN: Pi 有意不在 core 中内建 subagent orchestration policy；官方项目说明建议使用独立 Pi 进程或 extensions，因此 delegation 语义留在 minimal core 之外。
display_text.en: Pi intentionally omits a built-in subagent orchestration policy; its official project guidance points users to separate Pi processes or extensions so delegation semantics remain outside the minimal core.

evidence.title: Pi intentionally omitted features
evidence.locator: What Pi intentionally omits — No sub-agents

notes: This is a negative core-design claim, not a claim that the Pi ecosystem lacks subagent packages.
